title: Can LLMs Take Retrieved Information with a Grain of Salt?
abstract: arXiv:2605.06919v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models have demonstrated impressive retrieval-augmented capabilities. However, a crucial area remains underexplored: their ability to appropriately adapt responses to the certainty of the retrieved information. It is a limitation with real consequences in high-stakes domains like medicine and finance. We evaluate eight LLMs on their context-certainty obedience, measuring how well they adjust responses to match expressed context certainty. Our analysis reveals systematic limitations: LLMs fail to reproduce their prior outputs after observing an uncertain context, respond to expressed certainties in a distorted way, and overrely on complex contexts. To address these, we propose an interaction strategy combining prior reminders (feeding the model's own context-free answer back into the prompt), context-certainty recalibration, and context simplification. translated_title: 大语言模型能否对检索到的信息保持审慎态度？
translated_abstract: 大语言模型已经展现出令人印象深刻的检索增强能力。然而，一个关键领域仍未被充分探索：它们能否根据检索信息的确定性恰当地调整回应。这一局限在医学和金融等高风险领域会产生实际后果。我们评估了八个大语言模型在“上下文确定性服从”方面的表现，衡量它们调整回应以匹配所表达上下文确定性的能力。我们的分析揭示了系统性局限：大语言模型在观察到不确定的上下文后无法复现其先前的输出，对所表达的确定性以失真的方式做出回应，并且过度依赖复杂的上下文。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种交互策略，结合了先验提醒（将模型自身无上下文的答案反馈回提示中）、上下文确定性重新校准和上下文简化。该方法平均减少了25%的服从错误，且不损害性能。
tldr: 本研究评估了八个大语言模型根据检索信息确定性调整回应的能力，发现其存在无法保持先前输出、对确定性反应失真和过度依赖复杂上下文等系统性缺陷，并提出结合先验提醒、确定性重新校准和上下文简化的交互策略，平均减少25%的服从错误。
en_tdlr: This study evaluates eight LLMs' ability to adapt responses to the certainty of retrieved information, reveals systematic limitations such as failure to preserve prior outputs and distorted responses to expressed certainties, and proposes an interaction strategy combining prior reminders, certainty recalibration, and context simplification that reduces obedience errors by 25% on average.
